title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Agla–Kalakopa–Bandura) (Agla Zamindar Bari (Agla Jamindar Bari))
planning_notes: Add-on: Joykrishnapur Zamindar Bari, north of Shikaripara (see joykrishnapur-zamindar-bari).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Old Dhaka heritage walk) (Ahsan Manzil (Dhaka Nawab Bari))
planning_notes: For a longer walk, add the Sutrapur Zamindar Bari (Revati Mohan Das House) and Rose Garden Palace in Tikatuli. Both are 2–3 km north-east of Ahsan Manzil (see sutrapur-zamindar-bari and rose-garden-palace).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Savar and the Dhaka–Aricha highway) (Arapara Zamindar Bari (Rai Shashi Nibas), Savar)
Suggested day-trip circuit (Ichamati heritage loop, Nawabganj) (Baktarnagar Zamindar Bari (Sab Bari))
planning_notes: Alternative: from Bandura, continue south to Joypara and Mainot Ghat (Dohar) on the Padma for sunset. The Channel i article (2025) treats Dohar and Nawabganj as one day trip.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Saturia–Dhamrai) (Balia Zamindar Bari (Baliya Jamidar Bari))
planning_notes: You can also add Gangutia Zamindar Bari (Roy Bari) in south-west Dhamrai (gangutia-zamindar-bari). It is a lived-in family home, so get permission first.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Dhamrai Roy Chowdhury trail) (Belishwar Zamindar Bari (Belishwar Jamindar Bari))
Suggested day-trip circuit (Savar heritage and roses) (Birulia Zamindar Bari (Rajanikanta Ghosh House))
planning_notes: Banglapedia also lists the 8th-century Raja Harish Chandra's homestead (Buddhist monastery ruins at Majidpur, east of Savar Bazar) among Savar's antiquities. It is an option for history-minded visitors.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (South Dhamrai) (Dhar Zamindar Bari (Nannar Rajbari))
Suggested day-trip circuit (West Dhamrai) (Gangutia Zamindar Bari (Roy Bari))
Suggested day-trip circuit (north-west Nawabganj back roads) (Joykrishnapur Zamindar Bari)
Suggested day-trip circuit (Kallani (Kalyani) Zamindar Bari)
linked_site_ids: JB-DHK-011; JB-DHK-015; JB-DHK-008; JB-DHK-006; JB-DHK-005; JB-DHK-009
planning_notes: No circuit is suggested until the village is located. Other Dhamrai estates are Rowail (rowail-zamindar-bari), Nannar (nanna-zamindar-bari), Belishwar (belishwar-zamindar-bari), Balia (baliya-zamindar-bari) and Gangutia (gangutia-zamindar-bari), plus Dhamrai town's Jagannath Roth and metal-casting workshops.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Old Dhaka and Keraniganj) (Keraniganj Zamindar Bari (Prashanta Karmakar's House))
planning_notes: Long-day alternative: continue south-west through Keraniganj and over the Kaikobad bridge to the Kalakopa houses in Nawabganj (see kalakopa-zamindar-bari).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Kalakopa–Bandura–Baktarnagar) (Kokil Pyari Zamindar Bari (Kalakopa Zamindar Bari))
planning_notes: Add-ons: Agla village, the birthplace of poet Kaikobad and seat of the Agla zamindar-pirs, is nearby in the same upazila. Joykrishnapur Zamindar Bari is north of Shikaripara.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Old Dhaka palaces) (Rose Garden Palace)
planning_notes: If you visit on a Sunday, skip Rose Garden and Lalbagh Fort. If you visit on a Thursday, skip Ahsan Manzil.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (South Dhamrai) (Rowail Zamindar Bari (Rowail Jamindar Bari))
Suggested day-trip circuit (Buriganga riverfront and Old Dhaka) (Ruplal House)
planning_notes: Add Rose Garden Palace in Tikatuli (see rose-garden-palace, closed Sundays) if you start early or skip Lalbagh.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Aminbazar–Savar) (Savar Dewan Bari (Dewanbari / Haji Bari), Aminbazar)
Suggested day-trip circuit (Savar heritage) (Savar Zamindar Bari (Rakhal Chandra Saha's House))
Suggested day-trip circuit (Old Dhaka zamindar houses) (Sutrapur Zamindar Bari (Revati Mohan Das House))
Suggested day-trip circuit (Amirabad Estate (Biswas Bari))
planning_notes: Combine with Ishan Gopalpur Babu Bari (same union, about 3.5 km east) and Moyez Manzil in town for a "two families of Faridpur" day.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Baishrashi Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: 1. Baishrashi in the morning. 2. Atrashi Biswa Zaker Manzil, nearby in Sadarpur. 3. The Padma–Arial Khan river view. 4. On the way back, Raipara Zamindar Bari near Bhanga (see the Raipara Zamindar Bari page) before taking the expressway home.

title: Suggested trip (Baushkhali Zamindar Bari (Singha Bari))
planning_notes: Too far for a comfortable day trip. Stay overnight in Faridpur and pair it with Moyez Manzil and Jasimuddin's house (see the Moyez Manzil page).

title: Suggested trip (Chandra Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Plan an overnight trip. Alfadanga upazila has several other houses listed by FaridpurCity, none documented yet: - Buraich Khan Bahadur Zamindar Bari, visited by the British High Commissioner in 2023 - Folia Munshi Bari - Mohisharghop Saha Bari - Titurkandi Zamindar Bari - Mirganj Nilkuthi, an indigo factory

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Ishan Gopalpur Zamindar Bari (Babu Bari))
planning_notes: 1. Moyez Manzil in Faridpur town. 2. Ishan Gopalpur Babu Bari. 3. Amirabad / Biswas Bari, in the same union about 3.5 km further west. 4. Jasimuddin's house at Ambikapur on the way back into town.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Kanaipur Zamindar Bari (Shikdar Bari))
planning_notes: 1. Moyez Manzil in Faridpur town. 2. Pallikobi Jasimuddin's house at Ambikapur. 3. Afternoon at Kanaipur Shikdar Bari. 4. Rosogolla at Tetultola before the ride home. See the Moyez Manzil page for the town sights.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Moyez Manzil)
planning_notes: 1. Leave Dhaka early by bus or train. 2. Moyez Manzil in the morning. 3. Pallikobi Jasimuddin's house and museum at Ambikapur (Tk 20, 9 AM–5 PM). 4. Either Ishan Gopalpur Babu Bari to the north-west or Kanaipur Shikdar Bari to the south-west (each about 6–10 km). 5. Sunset on the Padma bank at Dhalar Mor, then back to Dhaka.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Raipara Zamindar Bari (Roy Bari))
planning_notes: Bhanga is the closest Faridpur stop to Dhaka: 1. Raipara in the morning. 2. Pathrail Mosque, a Sultanate-era mosque in Bhanga upazila. 3. Baishrashi Zamindar Bari in Sadarpur (see the Baishrashi Zamindar Bari page). Two more houses listed in Bhanga, Algi and Paranpur (Amiya Saha's house), have no records yet.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Baldha family trail) (Baldha Zamindar Bari (Chowdhury Bari))
planning_notes: Alternative: Kashimpur Zamindar Bari is on the Gazipur–Kaliakair road, a separate half-day from Dhaka.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Kaliakair zamindar houses) (Baliadi Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Alternative: with a private car you can continue south-west from Baliadi along the Kaliakair–Dhamrai road toward Dhamrai. TouristPlaces lists Baliati Palace about 17 km away in a straight line. The road distance is longer; plan this only with your own transport.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Gazipur) (Bhawal Rajbari (Bhawal Raj Palace))
planning_notes: Alternatives: swap the national park for Nuhash Polli (Humayun Ahmed's estate, Pirujali) or the Bangabandhu Safari Park (Sreepur). Kashimpur Zamindar Bari is a short detour toward Dhaka. Local food: Gazipur is known for jackfruit (Kapasia and Sreepur, in summer). (General local knowledge, not from the cited sources.)

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Gazipur zamindar houses by road) (Kashimpur Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Alternative: pair Kashimpur with Baldha Zamindar Bari and Bhawal Rajbari on the Joydebpur side, following the Kashimpur–Baldha estate link the travel writers mention.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Gazipur city heritage) (Palasona Zamindar Bari (Gachha))
Suggested day-trip circuit (Kaliakair zamindar houses) (Sreefaltali Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Families with children can swap Mohera for Nandan Park (about 5 km away, near Nabinagar–Chandra road).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Arpara Munshi Bari)
planning_notes: Pair with Ulpur Zamindar Bari, about 10 minutes away by easybike (Tk 10 per person in 2013), and, with an early start, Ujani Rajbari in Muksudpur.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Choto Bongram Zamindar Bari (Bhuiya Bari))
planning_notes: Spend the day in Muksudpur: Choto Bongram, the Maharajpur Rajbari next door, Choto Roy Bari at Batikamari, and Ujani Rajbari in the same upazila. The Baushkhali Zamindar Bari is about 8 km to the west across the Faridpur border.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Choto Roy Bari, Batikamari)
planning_notes: Combine it with the Choto Bongram Bhuiya Bari and the Maharajpur Rajbari a few kilometres west.

title: Suggested circuit (Girish Chandra Sen's Zamindar Bari (Kashiani Zamindar Bari 1))
planning_notes: Pair it with Sakhi Charan Roy's house, now a land office, in the same upazila. Kashiani is on the Bhanga-Gopalganj road, so it can be a stop on the way to Ulpur and Arpara. Orakandi Thakurbari, the Matua pilgrimage centre, is also in Kashiani upazila.

title: Suggested circuit (Horinahati Zamindar Bari (Sachchidananda's House))
planning_notes: It is too far for a comfortable day trip from Dhaka. Combine it with Ulpur and Arpara Munshi Bari on an overnight trip based in Gopalganj town.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Maharajpur Rajbari (Bose Bari))
planning_notes: Walk between this house and Choto Bongram, then go on 4 km to Choto Roy Bari, Batikamari. Ujani Rajbari is in the same upazila.

title: Suggested circuit (Sakhi Charan Roy's Zamindar Bari (Kashiani Zamindar Bari 2))
planning_notes: Pair it with Girish Chandra Sen's house in the same upazila, then continue south to Ulpur if there is time. Orakandi Thakurbari, the Matua pilgrimage centre, is also in Kashiani.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Ujani Rajbari (Ujani Zamindar Bari))
linked_site_ids: JB-DHK-041; JB-DHK-042; JB-DHK-034; JB-DHK-035; JB-DHK-039; JB-DHK-036; JB-DHK-059
planning_notes: Ujani sits between Dhaka and Gopalganj town, so it combines well with Ulpur and Arpara Munshi Bari further south-east. Three more houses lie a short drive away in Muksudpur: the Choto Bongram Bhuiya Bari, the Maharajpur Rajbari and Choto Roy Bari, Batikamari. For the story of the gifted estate, pair it instead with Khalia and the Rajaram temple near Tekerhat on the Dhaka-Khulna highway.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Ulpur Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Morning at Ulpur, then 10 minutes by easybike to Arpara Munshi Bari on the Beel Route Canal. With an early start, continue to Ujani Rajbari in Muksudpur on the way back towards Dhaka, or go south to the Bangabandhu mausoleum at Tungipara. A 2013 visitor returned via Tekerhat (Madaripur) to catch a Dhaka bus.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Austagram Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Bolai Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Dhola Zamindar Bari (Girish Chandra Pal's House))
planning_notes: Tarail circuit (from Kishoreganj): Dhola, Taljanga Zamindar Bari, and the Saheb Bari Mosque and zamindar house at Jawar (1534 inscription).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Gangatia Zamindar Bari (Manab Babu's House))
planning_notes: Kishoreganj day: Gangatia in the morning, Jangalbari Fort after lunch, then Pagla Mosque and Sholakia Eidgah in town. In the monsoon, add a boat trip on Mithamain haor the next day.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Gopinathpur Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Haibatnagar Zamindar Bari (Dewan Bari))
planning_notes: Isa Khan trail: Haibatnagar Dewan Bari, then Jangalbari Fort in Karimganj, then Gangatia Zamindar Bari in Hossainpur. In town: Pagla Mosque and Sholakia Eidgah.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Itna Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Jangalbari Fort (Isa Khan's fort))
planning_notes: Isa Khan and Kishoreganj day: Jangalbari Fort, Haibatnagar Dewan Bari, then Gangatia Zamindar Bari. Add Masua (Ray family home) if you stay overnight.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Jawar Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Tarail circuit: Jawar, Taljanga and Dhola.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Masua Zamindar Bari (Satyajit Ray's ancestral home))
planning_notes: Ray heritage day: Masua in the morning, then Jangalbari Fort (Isa Khan) and Gangatia Zamindar Bari near Kishoreganj town, ending at the Pagla Mosque and Sholakia Eidgah in town.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Nikli Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Pakundia Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Sararchar Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Suharmul Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Taljanga Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Tarail circuit: Taljanga, Dhola Zamindar Bari and Jawar (Saheb Bari Mosque, 1534).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Uri Ondho Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Khalia Zamindar Bari (Rajaram Roy Chowdhury's Estate))
planning_notes: Tekerhat is a highway junction, so Khalia combines with Ujani Rajbari (Muksudpur), the estate that gave Khalia away, or with Madaripur town's Kulpaddi and Mithapur houses.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Kulpaddi Zamindar Bari (Saha Bari))
planning_notes: Madaripur town: Kulpaddi in the morning, Shakuni Lake and the Shah Madar dargah at midday, then Mithapur Zamindar Bari by autorickshaw. On the way back to Dhaka stop at Mostafapur for Parbat Bagan and the Poddar house.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Mithapur Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Combine with Kulpaddi Zamindar Bari and Shakuni Lake in town, and Mostafapur on the road back.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Mostofapur New Zamindar Bari (Ras Bihari Parbat's House, Parbat Bagan))
planning_notes: Mostafapur is on the highway just before Madaripur town: see the Parbat house and Poddar house, then continue to Kulpaddi and Mithapur.

title: Suggested circuit (Mostofapur Old Zamindar Bari (Suresh Chandra Poddar's House))
planning_notes: Visit together with Parbat Bagan, then continue to Kulpaddi and Mithapur in Madaripur.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Manikganj heritage loop) (Baliati Palace (Baliati Zamindar Bari))
planning_notes: Optional nearby stops: Dhankora Zamindar Bari (also in Saturia), Nahar Garden (Saturia, Tk 20 entry) and Matta Moth (Manikganj Sadar).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Dhankora Zamindar Bari (Babu Hem Chandra Roy Chowdhury House))
Suggested day-trip circuit (Teota Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Pair it with Baliati Palace: Baliati in the morning, Teota after lunch and sunset on the Jamuna at Aricha. See the circuit on the Baliati Palace page.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Balashur Zamindar Bari (Jadunath Roy's House))
planning_notes: Pair with the Bhagyakul riverbank and bazar, the Maijpara Math at Rarikhal, and the Sir J. C. Bose complex for a full Sreenagar day. Arial Beel is next door and is at its best in the monsoon and early winter.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Betka Zamindar Bari (Ghoshal Bari))
planning_notes: Pair with Outshahi in the same upazila, the Sonarang Jora Math, and Idrakpur Fort in Munshiganj town.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Bhagyakul Zamindar Bari (Roy Bari))
planning_notes: Sreenagar heritage loop (half to full day): Bhagyakul bazar and riverbank, then Jadunath Roy's house and the Bikrampur Museum at Balashur next door (see the Balashur Zamindar Bari page), then the Maijpara Math at Rarikhal (see the Maijpara Zamindar Bari page) and the Sir J. C. Bose complex close by.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Fuldi Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: To be added once the house is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Horikhali Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: See the Malkhanagar Zamindar Bari page.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Idrakpur Fort)
planning_notes: Munshiganj town day: Idrakpur Fort, then Baba Adam's Mosque and Rampal Dighi at Rampal, then Atish Dipankar's birthplace at Bajrayogini (all listed by Travel Mate as nearby). Add Sonarang Jora Math and Ghoshal Bari, Betka in Tongibari if time allows.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Kolma Zamindar Bari (Laxmikanta Babu's House))
planning_notes: To be added once the location is confirmed.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Maijpara Zamindar Bari (Roy Bari))
planning_notes: The Sir J. C. Bose complex (Bose's ancestral home, Rarikhal) is close by. Add Balashur and Bhagyakul for a full Sreenagar day.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Malkhanagar Zamindar Bari (Bose Bari))
planning_notes: Combine with other Sirajdikhan sites: Horikhali (if confirmed) and the Rajendra Babu house at Ichhapura recorded by the same blog.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Mirkadim Zamindar Bari (Panchu Bepari's House))
planning_notes: Combine with Idrakpur Fort in Munshiganj town and Baba Adam's Mosque at Rampal.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Outshahi Zamindar Bari (Bijoy Kor Babu's House))
planning_notes: Combine with Ghoshal Bari at Betka in the same upazila, the Sonarang Jora Math, and Idrakpur Fort in Munshiganj town.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Rupganj–Araihazar) (Baliapara Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Another option is to head south about 13 km to Sonargaon for Boro Sardar Bari, the Folk Art Museum and Panam Nagar, a historic merchant town. The 2016 "Save the Heritages of Bangladesh" tour combined Baliapara, Araihazar and Sonargaon in a single day.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Sonargaon and Araihazar) (Boro Sardar Bari (Bara Sardar Bari))
planning_notes: The Gopaldi (Sadasadi) and Satgram zamindar houses in Araihazar are also within reach, but you cannot fit them all into one day.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Araihazar zamindar trail) (Gopaldi Zamindar Bari (Sadasadi Zamindar Bari / Bhuiyan Bari))
planning_notes: If you are heading south instead, Boro Sardar Bari and Panam Nagar in Sonargaon are about an hour away via Madanpur. Panam Nagar is a merchant town, not a zamindar estate.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Narayanganj river heritage) (Murapara Rajbari (Murapara Zamindar Bari))
planning_notes: Banglapedia also lists Zinda Park at Murapara as a local attraction.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Dhaka–Sylhet highway heritage) (Satgram Zamindar Bari (Jogesh Babu's House))
planning_notes: Risingbd also suggests Boro Sardar Bari, the Folk Art Museum and Panam Nagar in Sonargaon. They are better saved for a separate day.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Meghna and Palash zamindar trail) (Balapur Zamindar Bari (Nabin Chandra Saha Zamindar Bari))
planning_notes: Travel times between stops are estimates; confirm locally. Wari-Bateshwar (Belabo) is in the same district but much farther north-east, so it needs its own trip.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Palash–Narsingdi zamindar trail) (Ghorashal Zamindar Bari (Monu Mia's Zamindar Bari))
planning_notes: This is a full day. For a shorter trip, pair Ghorashal with Danga only. Travel times between stops are estimates; confirm locally.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Lakshman Saha Zamindar Bari (Danga Zamindar Bari))
planning_notes: Alternative from the south: combine Danga with Murapara Rajbari (Rupganj) by way of Kanchan Bridge and the Mayar Bari Mor auto route.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Rajbari town) (Lakshmikol Raja Bari (site))
planning_notes: 1. Lakshmikol site and Collectorate Dighi. 2. Rajbari Government High School "Red Building", built by the Banibaha Majumdar zamindars (1878 or 1892). 3. Dadshi Mazar. 4. The Pachuria zamindar houses, 7–8 km east (see the Pachuria Zamindar Houses page). 5. River fish at Goalanda / Daulatdia ghat on the way back by the ferry route.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Pachuria Zamindar Houses (Peshkar Bari))
planning_notes: 1. Pachuria houses. 2. Lakshmikol Raja Bari site and Collectorate Dighi in Rajbari town (see the Lakshmikol Raja Bari page). 3. The Banibaha zamindars' Red Building school. 4. Goalanda Ghat, the old river-steamer terminus, for Padma fish before taking the ferry route home.

title: Suggested circuit (Choygaon Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Bhedarganj lies between Shariatpur town and Naria, so Choygaon fits into a Shariatpur day with Rudrakar and Kartikpur.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Kartikpur Zamindar Bari (Chowdhury Bari))
planning_notes: Shariatpur works as a day trip since the Padma Bridge: Rudrakar Math and Zamindar Bari near Shariatpur town in the morning, Kartikpur after lunch, and the Padma riverbank at Naria or Sureshwar before heading back. (Shariatpur's sweets and Padma ilish are general local knowledge, not from the cited sources.)

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Rudrakar Zamindar Bari and Math (Babu Bari))
planning_notes: Rudrakar in the morning, then east to Kartikpur in Naria, with the Padma riverbank at Naria or Sureshwar before returning over the bridge.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Alishakanda Zamindar Bari (Roy Bari))
planning_notes: Visit from Tangail town together with Santosh (profile) and Aloa (profile).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Aloa Zamindar Bari (Aloa Rajbari))
planning_notes: Pair Aloa with Santosh (profile) and Karatia (profile). All three are within a short auto ride of Tangail town. Finish with Porabari chomchom.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Basail Zamindar Bari (Charu Chandra Roy Bari))
planning_notes: Basail is close to Mohera (profile) and Delduar (profile).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Delduar Zamindar Bari (North House / Uttar Taraf))
Suggested circuit (Dhalapara Zamindar Bari (Chowdhury Bari))
planning_notes: Dhalapara is off the main Tangail heritage trail. Combine it with Ghatail and, on an overnight trip, with Dhanbari (profile) further north.

title: Suggested circuit (overnight) (Dhanbari Nawab Palace (Dhanbari Zamindar Bari))
planning_notes: Day 1: Dhaka to Dhanbari Nawab Palace and the Nawab Shahi mosque. Stay at the resort or in Tangail. Day 2: Hemnagar Zamindar Bari (Porir Dalan) (profile) via Gopalpur, then the 201-domed mosque at Pathalia, Gopalpur, and back to Dhaka. Optionally add Madhupur National Park.

title: Suggested circuit (overnight) (Hemnagar Zamindar Bari (Porir Dalan))
planning_notes: Hemnagar is too far for a relaxed day trip. Pair it with Dhanbari Nawab Palace (profile) and the 201-domed mosque at Pathalia, Gopalpur. Stay at Dhanbari's resort or in Tangail. Tangail's sari village of Pathrail is on the way back.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Karatia Zamindar Bari (Karatia Rajbari))
Suggested day-trip circuit (Tangail zamindar trail) (Mohera Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: A 2019 travel writer covered five Tangail zamindar baris in one day for under Tk 750 per person, not counting food. Weekend version: stay overnight in Tangail. On the way back on day 2, stop at Chandra and detour to Bhawal Rajbari and Bhawal National Park in Gazipur (see the Bhawal Rajbari page).

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Mokna Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Combine with Nagarpur Chowdhury Bari (profile) and Pakutia Zamindar Bari (profile). Finish with Porabari chomchom.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Nagarpur Zamindar Bari (Chowdhury Bari))
planning_notes: Combine with Pakutia (profile) and Baliati (profile) on the Manikganj side, or with Mokna (profile) across the Dhaleshwari. Snack at Nagarpur bazar and pick up Porabari chomchom in Tangail.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Manikganj–Tangail border) (Pakutia Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Have lunch near Baliati. Tangail's Porabari chomchom is the classic sweet to bring home.

title: Suggested day-trip circuit (Santosh Zamindar Bari (Santosh Rajbari))
Suggested circuit (Jamalpur) (Durmut Haji Fazel Mahmud Talukdar Bari)
planning_notes: Jamalpur is 4-5 hours from Dhaka, so plan an overnight. Routes between them are not confirmed, so check locally. Pairs with: Mansurnagar Dewan Bari, Kamarchak Dewan Bari, Kamini Bhaban (Bangaon Zamindar Bari).

title: Suggested circuit (Derai and Jagannathpur) (Bhatipara Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Combine with Pailgaon in Jagannathpur on a day out from Sylhet or Sunamganj; Derai is also the home area of Baul Shah Abdul Karim (his house at Ujandhal is on the district portal). Pairs with: Pailgaon Zamindar Bari.

title: Suggested circuit (Sunamganj town) (Gourarang Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Pair with Hason Raja's house in Tegharia on the same morning; both are within a few km of the bus stand. A weekend from Dhaka by night bus. Pairs with: Hason Raja's House, Lakkhansree (Tegharia).

title: Suggested circuit (Sunamganj town) (Hason Raja's House, Lakkhansree (Tegharia))
planning_notes: A weekend from Dhaka: night bus to Sunamganj, morning at Hason Raja's house on the Surma at Tegharia, then Gourarang 3 km west. With a second day, cross to Panail in Dowarabazar, or take a boat or bike north to Tanguar Haor, Niladri Lake and the Laur ruins at Halhalia. Hason Raja's grave is at Gazir Dorga in town. Routes between sites are not confirmed, so check locally. Pairs with: Gourarang Zamindar Bari, Panail Zamindar Bari.

title: Suggested circuit (Tahirpur and Tanguar Haor) (Howli Zamindar Bari (Laur Rajbari))
planning_notes: Best as part of a two-day Tanguar Haor trip from Sunamganj: houseboat or bike to Tahirpur, the Laur ruins at Halhalia, Niladri Lake, Jadukata river and Barekker Tila. Sukhair is across the haor in Dharmapasha by boat in the monsoon. Pairs with: Sukhair Zamindar Bari.

title: Suggested circuit (Jagannathpur and Derai) (Pailgaon Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: From Sylhet, a long day can take in Pailgaon in Jagannathpur and the Bhatipara mosque on the Derai road; both are reached from the Sylhet-Sunamganj highway at Shantiganj. Not a day trip from Dhaka. Pairs with: Bhatipara Zamindar Bari.

title: Suggested circuit (Sunamganj and Dowarabazar) (Panail Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: On a Sunamganj weekend, add Panail after Hason Raja's house; Dowarabazar is across the Surma from Sunamganj town. Routes are not confirmed. Pairs with: Hason Raja's House, Lakkhansree (Tegharia).

title: Suggested circuit (Dharmapasha haor) (Rajapur Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Visit with Sukhair Zamindar Bari next door. Ask in Sukhair which building is the Rajapur zamindars' house. Pairs with: Sukhair Zamindar Bari.

title: Suggested circuit (Dharmapasha haor) (Sukhair Zamindar Bari)
planning_notes: Two days from Dhaka: train to Mohanganj, then Dharmapasha. Visit Sukhair and the neighbouring Rajapur branch seat together. In the monsoon a boat trip can continue to Tanguar Haor and the Laur ruins at Halhalia on the Tahirpur side. Seasonal access; confirm locally. Pairs with: Rajapur Zamindar Bari.

title: Suggested circuit (Sylhet to Kulaura) (Babur Bari (Kamakhya Babur Bari), Fenchuganj)
planning_notes: Not a day trip from Dhaka. Fenchuganj sits between Sylhet and Kulaura, so it can break the journey between Sylhet city and Prithimpassa Nawab Bari. Routes are not confirmed, so check locally. Pairs with: Museum of Rajas' (Hason Raja Museum), Zindabazar, Prithimpassa Nawab Bari.

title: Suggested circuit (Jaintiapur and Jaflong) (Jaintiapur Rajbari (Jaintia Royal Palace))
planning_notes: Not a day trip from Dhaka. From Sylhet, Jaintiapur is on the way to Jaflong and Tamabil, so a weekend works: day 1 Sylhet city (Museum of Rajas, Manipuri Rajbari, Shah Jalal's dargah); day 2 Jaintiapur Rajbari, Jaintiaswari Bari and the megalith field, then Jaflong. Routes between sites are not confirmed, so check locally. Sylhet's satkora beef and Panshi's bhuna khichuri are the usual food stops. Pairs with: Manipuri Rajbari, Mirzajangal, Museum of Rajas' (Hason Raja Museum), Zindabazar.

title: Suggested circuit (Sylhet city) (Manipuri Rajbari, Mirzajangal)
planning_notes: Not a day trip from Dhaka. Walk it with the Tin Mandir at Lamabazar and the Museum of Rajas in Zindabazar on a Sylhet city day. Pairs with: Museum of Rajas' (Hason Raja Museum), Zindabazar, Jaintiapur Rajbari (Jaintia Royal Palace).

title: Suggested circuit (Sylhet city) (Museum of Rajas' (Hason Raja Museum), Zindabazar)
planning_notes: Not a day trip from Dhaka. In Sylhet city it pairs with the Manipuri Rajbari at Mirzajangal and the Tin Mandir at Lamabazar, Ali Amjad's clock at Chandnighat, and the dargahs of Shah Jalal and Shah Paran. Rampasha (Bishwanath) and Jaintiapur are out-of-town add-ons. Pairs with: Manipuri Rajbari, Mirzajangal, Rampasha Zamindar Bari (Hason Raja's ancestral home), Jaintiapur Rajbari (Jaintia Royal Palace).

title: Suggested circuit (Hason Raja trail) (Rampasha Zamindar Bari (Hason Raja's ancestral home))

Routes between sites are not confirmed, so check locally. Pairs with: Museum of Rajas' (Hason Raja Museum), Zindabazar.

title: Suggested circuit (Paikgachha and Tala) (Katipara House of Madhusudan Dutt's Maternal Family)
planning_notes: Combine with the Tetulia Jami Mosque and Salam Manzil at Tala, about 40-50 km north-west by road (estimate), on a 2-day trip based in Khulna. Madhusudan's birthplace at Sagardari (Keshabpur, Jashore) is across the Kapotaksha and makes a natural pairing; the Jashore thread covers it. Acharya P. C. Ray's house at Raruli is about 2 km away, so see both together. Kopilmuni bazar, a short way up the river, has Rai Bahadur Binod Bihari Sadhu's house (a lead, not yet recorded). Pairs with: Acharya Prafulla Chandra Ray's House, Raruli, Tetulia Jami Mosque, Salam Manzil, Tetulia Zamindar Bari.

planning_notes: Make it part of a 2-day Koyra trip: Bedkashi on day one, and on day two the Masjidkur Mosque (15th-16th century, Department of Archaeology protected; a lead, not recorded here) and a boat along the Sundarbans edge. Shyamnagar's Ishwaripur sites are across the rivers to the west but are a long way round by road.

Narail is also the home town of the painter S. M. Sultan, whose museum and house are by the Chitra (not checked here). Routes between the sites are not confirmed. Pairs with: Hatbaria Zamindar Bari.

planning_notes: See the Rajbari ruins, the Jessoreshwari Temple and the Hammamkhana together on foot, then Nakipur on the way back to Shyamnagar. A Sundarbans boat trip from Munshiganj makes it a full weekend. Pairs with: Jessoreshwari Kali Temple, Ishwaripur Hammamkhana, Nakipur Zamindar Bari (Haricharan Roy Chowdhury's House).

Try Satkhira's sandesh and Sundarbans honey. Pairs with: Ishwaripur Rajbari (Pratapaditya's Palace Ruins), Jessoreshwari Kali Temple, Ishwaripur Hammamkhana.
